title: Gathering at the Ancient Tomb
summary: Lin Ke-er's party sets out into the Sky Flame Mountain Range with Lin Dong, Little Flame and the boastful Lin Chen. Lin Ke-er explains that only experts of the three Creation realms can break the tomb's seal, and that the clan's young representative Lin Langtian will come to do it. At night, Song Dao of the Blade Slaughter Gang raids the camp, and Lin Ke-er cuts down his men with a Soul Treasure sword. Lin Dong beats Song Dao, a Yuan Dan perfect fighter, with the Qimen Seal and Myriad Transformation Flame, and with Little Mink's help breaks the Yuan Dan he throws. At the tomb, the Wang Clan's Wang Pan and Wang Yan, the Qin Clan's Qin Shi, and Lin Langtian, flying in at Qi Creation, gather. Ling Qingzhu of the Nine Heavens Taiqing Palace comes for the Huangpu Clan, and the young experts break the seal together. Everyone rushes into the tomb after the Nirvana Heart.
events: Lin Dong leaves home for the tomb with Lin Ke-er's party, including Lin Chen.
Lin Ke-er says only experts of the three Creation realms can break the seal, and Lin Langtian will come.
Song Dao's Blade Slaughter Gang raids the camp; Lin Ke-er's Soul Treasure sword kills his men.
Lin Dong defeats Song Dao and shatters his Yuan Dan, leaving him crippled.
Lin Ke-er scolds Lin Chen for looking down on side-branch members.
At the tomb camp, Wang Pan, Lin Langtian, Wang Yan and Qin Shi arrive; Lin Dong sees how far behind he is.
Ling Qingzhu arrives for the Huangpu Clan; the seal is broken and everyone rushes in.
cultivation: Song Dao is Yuan Dan perfect, and Lin Dong is Yuan Dan advanced. Lin Langtian is already at Qi Creation. Wang Yan and Qin Shi are at Form Creation.
